scripts.//: The Jupyter widget and the R Shiny viewer share js/index.ts; js/shiny.ts adapts the Shiny model to it.
scripts.build-jupyter: esbuild js/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --minify-syntax --sourcemap --banner:js='// Generated from js/index.ts by `npm run build-jupyter` / `make jupyter`. Edit TypeScript sources, not this file.' --outfile=python/gen/static/jupyter_widget.js
scripts.build-r: esbuild js/shiny.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --minify-syntax --banner:js='// Generated from js/shiny.ts by `npm run build-r` / `make r`. Edit TypeScript sources, not this file.' --outfile=../gen-r/inst/widget/genplot.esm.js
